name: mcpservercheck
one_liner: Offline static linter for MCP-server registration config files (.mcp.json, mcp.json, and the mcpServers / servers blocks that MCP clients read on install).
problem: MCP-server registration configs (client-side files a user pastes to install a server) are attack surface: they can name a shell interpreter with an inline eval flag, ship a plaintext http:// transport, embed a bearer literal in an env value, remote-fetch-and-execute in the command line, be structurally incomplete, reference an unpinned package, put a credential-shaped env key with an inline value, wildcard permissions, execute from a world-writable temp directory, or use a bare binary name subject to PATH-hijack. mcpservercheck reads the JSON/JSONL registration file the client will consume and flags ten shape defects with deterministic rules.
